high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the user "Aragorn" (@shiva_41kumar) on the platform X (formerly known as Twitter). The tweet reads: "Rohit Sharma left his gloves in front of the dugout. Signs of retirement?" The tweet includes two photographs: Left Photo: This shows two cricket players walking away from the camera on a grassy field. One player is wearing a white jersey with the number 8 on the back, while the other is wearing a white jersey with a helmet and holding a cricket bat. They appear to be walking towards the dugout
